description: Read your TacticalRMM fleet; run commands only after per-command human approval.
name: io.github.shin2344234/trmm-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your TacticalRMM backend, e.g. https://api.example.com
environmentVariables.name: TRMM_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: TacticalRMM API key bound to a read-only role. Used for all reads.
environmentVariables.name: TRMM_READONLY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: TacticalRMM API key permitted to execute. Only needed for elevate or command mode, and only used after an approval is granted.
environmentVariables.name: TRMM_COMMAND_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: readonly (default, 20 read tools), elevate (adds 8 execution tools, each requiring out-of-band human approval), or command (execution with no gate).
environmentVariables.name: TRMM_MCP_MODE

title: TacticalRMM
